newsitem.title: FINLAND: Raisio news seen linked to Benecol abroad.
newsitem.headline: Raisio news seen linked to Benecol abroad.

text.p: Finnish food, animal feed and chemicals group Raisio is expected to announce progress on its plans to market Benecol cholesterol-cutting margarine abroad -- especially the United States -- on Tuesday, analysts said.
The company earlier requested a share suspension pending a news conference at 1530/1230 GMT.
"I think they will announce cooperation with a U.S. firm for Benecol," said Ritva Ojala at Aktia Bank.
Raisio launched the patented margarine, proven to cut cholesterol levels, in Finland in November 1995 and plans a launch soon in Sweden.

But investors who bought the stock on high hopes for Benecol have been awaiting news of a U.S. launch. Its share has risen over 600 percent since the Finnish launch of the product and traded unchanged at 370 markka before the suspension.
Another analyst, requesting anonymity, said there were three possibilities from the conference, all focussed on the U.S.

She said besides a U.S. partner, Raisio could bring word of its feasibility study on a possible plant to produce the key ingredient for Benecol in the United States, or news of Food and Drug Association (FDA) approval for Benecol as a health product.
A third analyst, also requesting anonymity, said he expected news on a foreign partner for Benecol, also probably in the United States.
